summary: A Malayalam ad featuring a split-screen dialogue between an AI avatar and a man anxious about an upcoming English job interview. The AI recommends the MySivi app as a private, non-judgmental, and highly affordable way to practice English. The ad concludes with a call to action to install the app for a 1-rupee trial.
